Sound.summary.waiting.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's Sound menu button (and its screen-reader summary) until the page has had a click or a key: the browser plays no sound before one.

Sound.summary.on.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's Sound menu button (and its screen-reader summary) while sound is on.

Sound.summary.muted.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's Sound menu button (and its screen-reader summary) while sound is off (Sound on unticked, or the guest muted it).

Sound.summary.onMic.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's Sound menu button (and its screen-reader summary) while sound is on and the machine records from the microphone.

Sound.summary.mutedMic.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's Sound menu button (and its screen-reader summary) while sound is off and the machine records from the microphone.

Sound.micTag.note: Small tag drawn on the toolbar's Sound menu button while the machine records from the microphone: short for microphone.

Sound.on.note: Checkbox in the toolbar's Sound menu: the machine's sound plays (unticked: muted). A guest's own Master switch moves it too.

Sound.volume.note: Label of the volume slider in the toolbar's Sound menu.

Sound.mic.note: Checkbox in the toolbar's Sound menu: when the machine records, it gets the page's microphone (unticked: silence).

Sound.mic.title.message: When the machine records, the page asks for the microphone (the browser asks you the first time); off, the machine records silence
Sound.mic.title.note: Tooltip of the Microphone checkbox in the toolbar's Sound menu.

Sound.micRaw.note: Checkbox in the toolbar's Sound menu: the microphone without the browser's echo cancellation, noise suppression and gain control.

Sound.micRaw.title.message: The microphone as it comes: no echo cancellation, noise suppression or gain control (for music; for a call, leave it off)
Sound.micRaw.title.note: Tooltip of the Raw microphone checkbox in the toolbar's Sound menu.

Sound.hint.message: Kept in this browser. The browser plays sound once the page has had a click or a key.
Sound.hint.note: Fine print at the foot of the toolbar's Sound menu: the choices are remembered, and the browser's autoplay rule.

Sound.mic.denied.message: The browser refused the microphone: the machine records silence. Allow it in the site's settings, then turn Microphone off and on.
Sound.mic.denied.note: Fine print in the toolbar's Sound menu, shown when the machine records and the browser refused the page the microphone.

Sound.mic.asking.message: The machine is recording: the browser asks for the microphone.
Sound.mic.asking.note: Fine print in the toolbar's Sound menu, shown while the machine records and the browser is asking the user for the microphone.
